items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: But when I knew them, they had Joe Johnson on trumpet, Frankie Dooson trombone, Jim Dandy playing bass, Jeff Mumford playing guitar... I see it was, uh, Daniels on bass, Jeff Mumford on guitar, Sidney Bechet on clarinet.

ctx.x: Well did you get uptown to hear those bands like Frankie Dooson, and you mentioned Bolton only out at the-

Yeah, well, the Eagle band, I was very familiar with Eagle band. That was Frankie Dooson playing trombone, and Joe Johnson. See Jefferson? Yeah. Well Joe Johnson, man, just on all the Jeppe, the same color, same size and everything. He started trombone.
